newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Two fusions under way in Argentine pension system.
newsitem.headline: Two fusions under way in Argentine pension system.

text.p: Two of Argentina's largest pension funds, Maxima AFJP and Origenes AFJP, hope to soon absorb two smaller funds, the Superintendency of Pension and Retirement said Monday.
Superintendency President Walter Schulthess told Reuters Maxima is in the process of taking over Patrimonio AFJP. He added Origenes is expected to submit a proposal in June to buy Mas Vida AFJP.
"In the case of Maxima-Patrimonio ... a fusion process is now under way," he said.
"In the case of Origenes-Mas Vida they presented the necessary documents last Friday ... Origenes is buying Mas Vida's shares. We expect them to present their fusion plans around June 23."
A wave of mergers has marked Argentina's private pension system, launched three years ago.
The system currently manages $6.6 billion. ((--Jorge Otaola, Buenos Aires Newsroom +541 318-0652))
